modelspec.checkpoint.ParameterPath.title: ParameterPath
modelspec.checkpoint.ParameterPath.description: A stable canonical parameter path such as `TinyMLP.fc1.weight` (DESIGN.md § 2.3).

modelspec.observatory.Histogram.title: Histogram
modelspec.observatory.Histogram.description: The distribution of one tensor's elements in bins; bin i counts the elements in [bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]), so there is one more edge than counts, which ESS does not state here.

bin_edges.description: The bin edges in ascending order; an edge is null when it is NaN or ±inf, which Binary64 does not hold (wave observatory-1 coordinator, 2026-10-21).

modelspec.observatory.ParameterStatistic.title: ParameterStatistics
modelspec.observatory.ParameterStatistic.description: The norm and histogram of one parameter's values or gradient at a step, by its stable path (DESIGN.md § 2.3; epic:training-observatory).

norm.description: The norm; null when it is NaN or ±inf, which Binary64 does not hold (wave observatory-1 coordinator, 2026-10-21).

modelspec.observatory.StatisticsSubject.title: StatisticsSubject
modelspec.observatory.StatisticsSubject.description: Whether statistics describe a parameter's values or the gradient of the loss with respect to it (epic:training-observatory parameter/gradient histograms and norms).
